acceptance: Use the outputs of the three predecessor L12-MIN component tasks; do not reimplement their happy paths.
Persist one tenant-scoped Agora interaction, evidence record, DatasetVersion, and downstream handoff with correlated identifiers.
Acknowledge the handoff only after durable Policy Learning ingestion and make retry or duplicate delivery idempotent.
Produce one terminal shadow candidate linked to the DatasetVersion without seed fallback or live execution authority.
Create one governed Consultation request from the terminal candidate and persist a terminal memo or handoff linked to the same chain.
Prove a second tenant cannot read, acknowledge, replay, or correlate the first tenant's records.
Record before/after backlog counts and preserve historical pending rows unless their own durable consumer receipts justify acknowledgement.
